interfaces.connection: OEM gasket/basepan rests on defined weather-tight structural bearing surface; OEM ceiling template/bolts clamp the prescribed stack. Do not bolt a shroud or use a roof skin as an assumed load-bearing frame.
interfaces.missing: Exact unit basepan and gasket geometry, mass/CG, complete OEM hardware, compression and vehicle dynamic loads; custom roof ring and roof member design.
interfaces.assembly: Commercial rooftop unit to coach roof

interfaces.connection: Installed ADB uses the same OEM stack, with return/supply separation and filter/control access. Its published2.3in projection gives only a local un-recessed headroom probe.
interfaces.missing: Exact chosen ADB variant, moving door/seat/head envelopes, lighting/emergency paths and access; any recess alters roof/air paths and needs approval.

interfaces.connection: Recirculation cooling is not outdoor ventilation. Intake/filter/fan/duct supply and controlled exhaust/relief need a real protected path, with condensation and freeze control as needed.
interfaces.missing: Required outside flow, dirty-filter/static pressure, fan selection, inlet/exhaust separation including locomotive exhaust in both travel directions; no generic separation distance assumed.

interfaces.connection: Preserve unit intake/discharge flow and safe filter/lid/lift access, without trapping condensate or routing drains onto platforms, brakes, rails or electrical parts.
interfaces.missing: Correct directional OEM envelopes, actual drip/pan/drain provision, roof curvature/flatness, station swept envelope and safe service method.

interfaces.connection: A genuine undercar rail HVAC family remains an alternative; attach only to an engineered frame path, never the floor honeycomb.
interfaces.missing: Exact configured package/CAD/mass/capacity/electrical data, relative truck/suspension and coupling motion, intake clearance, impact/debris guards and service removal.

interfaces.connection: Selected branch protection/isolation, bonding and retained flexible vehicle connections must match generator, neutral scheme and load control. Roof, undercar and locomotive supply choices interact.
interfaces.missing: Actual current/PF/start/time data, electrical professional design, tested simultaneous/restart behavior and brake/egress independence; no OEM RV wire example adopted.
interfaces.assembly: Power and control across moving train

part_definition_status: No custom mount released. Actual mating faces/fasteners cannot yet be drawn without guessing; no replacement block model or speculative hole grid added.
review_sequence: Mechanical/HVAC specialist reconciles exact variant/manual conflicts and actual outside-air path.
Vehicle structural specialist defines roof/undercar load path with actual mass/CG and vehicle motion/load cases; body/suspension datum coordinated.
Produce recognizable assembled/section/mating-face geometry from controlled parts and custom designed pieces, then supported material, fits, joints, welds, fasteners and inspection detail.
One full-size nonenergized fit/service mockup before roof cut or production; record threshold/headroom/lighting/duct/filter/tool/removal clearances.
Qualified installers perform reviewed HVAC/electrical/refrigerant work; measured hot/cold, drainage, vibration, sound, airflow, leakage and live-load tests close accepted limits.
farm_crew_scope: Reviewed non-load-bearing fit mockup, access checks, measurement/travel records and installation assistance within released instructions.
specialist_scope: Roof/frame design, OEM compatibility, HVAC/refrigerant/electrical design and energized installation/testing.
